purpose: cheap post-freeze diagnostic of annotation-free positive-instance evidence on the audited rich gallery

candidate_evidence.definition: exact maximum mask IoU against every retained candidate from a different source

variants.g1_upstream_baseline: mean of global percentile ranks of frozen G1 logit and frozen upstream score
variants.g1_upstream_consensus_equal: equal mean of G1, upstream and consensus percentile ranks
variants.g1_upstream_consensus_product: geometric mean of the frozen two-score baseline and consensus percentile rank

decision.primary: actual binary-mask mean tumor Dice must exceed 0.28872948670665205
decision.failure_action: retire cross-source-consensus selection without weight, threshold, resolution, source or morphology sweep
